user.title: Lunch planner
user.description: Name of this planner, e.g. the household it plans lunches for.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: The meal database is kept in five to-do lists created by this integration. In an item's description put what to buy, one thing per line or separated by commas. A `season: 5-7` line limits the item to May–July. A ticked-off item is not drawn.

data.shopping_mode: When to send the shopping list

data_description.meal_days: Days that get a planned lunch.
data_description.soup_share: Only for "Soup or main course": the part of the week that gets a soup.
data_description.avoid_previous_week: Prefer meals that were not served the week before, when the database has enough of them.
data_description.draw_weekday: The draw plans the week starting on the next Monday. It must come before the shopping for Monday.
data_description.shopping_time: With "When I get home" this is the earliest time.
data_description.person: For "When I get home": the list waits until this person is home.
data_description.arrival_delay: Minutes at home before the list is sent.
data_description.no_shopping_days: Shopping for the day after is moved to the last earlier day, e.g. Monday's lunch is bought on Saturday when shops are closed on Sunday.
data_description.notify_services: Notify actions, e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone. The weekly plan and the shopping lists are sent here.
data_description.shopping_list: To-do list the things to buy are added to.

error.no_meal_days: Choose at least one lunch day.
error.no_shopping_day_left: Leave at least one day for shopping.
